home.intro: A community-built hub for creating, personalizing, and exploring code-created worlds — with connection as a future part of the journey.
home.now: Today: building the shared foundation, in public.

pillars.title: Create
pillars.detail: World makers shape spaces with code and share ideas through an open, versioned project format.

pillars.title: Personalize
pillars.detail: Visitors make approved choices that belong to their own saved experience, not the shared world template.

pillars.title: Explore
pillars.detail: Travel between imaginative places is the first proposed demo loop. Community features come later, after their boundaries are proven.

project.next: The proposed next milestone is a deliberately small local prototype: one project contract, a pair of original scenes, a safe interpreted-script boundary, and recoverable personalization. The S1 brief records its acceptance tests; implementation has not started.

progress.intro: The project is at its community-foundation stage. Here is the work that has evidence today, with source links you can inspect.

roadmap.intro: RPO HUB has a wide ambition. The roadmap keeps the next testable outcome visible without inventing dates, percentages, or finished capabilities.

community.intro: RPO HUB is being shaped in public, one careful step at a time. You can help without signing up for an application that does not exist yet.
